objective: Diagnosticar en solo lectura por que cada ciclo automatico sync_comercial_v2 procesa 130MID y CIENFUEGOS pero no alcanza ESTELAR, 130QRO y ORIGEN. Revisar Scheduler_BitacoraJobs para START/FINISH, duracion, success_count/failed_count y detectar ejecuciones truncadas o reinicios. No modificar codigo ni datos. No tocar sync_comercial_abiertas_v2. Etiqueta: Sincronizador.

queries.name: scheduler_bitacora_sync_comercial_v2
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (80) JobName,RunID,Accion,FechaAccion,Exito,MensajeError,DetallesJSON FROM dbo.Scheduler_BitacoraJobs WHERE JobName='sync_comercial_v2' ORDER BY FechaAccion DESC

queries.name: scheduler_start_finish_pairs
queries.sql: WITH x AS (SELECT RunID,MAX(CASE WHEN Accion='START' THEN FechaAccion END) AS started,MAX(CASE WHEN Accion='FINISH' THEN FechaAccion END) AS finished,MAX(CASE WHEN Accion='FINISH' THEN CAST(Exito AS int) END) AS exito,MAX(CASE WHEN Accion='FINISH' THEN MensajeError END) AS error FROM dbo.Scheduler_BitacoraJobs WHERE JobName='sync_comercial_v2' AND FechaAccion>=DATEADD(hour,-24,SYSUTCDATETIME()) GROUP BY RunID) SELECT TOP (50) RunID,started,finished,DATEDIFF(second,started,finished) AS duracion_seg,exito,error FROM x ORDER BY started DESC

queries.name: unfinished_scheduler_runs
queries.sql: WITH x AS (SELECT RunID,MAX(CASE WHEN Accion='START' THEN FechaAccion END) AS started,MAX(CASE WHEN Accion='FINISH' THEN FechaAccion END) AS finished FROM dbo.Scheduler_BitacoraJobs WHERE JobName='sync_comercial_v2' AND FechaAccion>=DATEADD(day,-2,SYSUTCDATETIME()) GROUP BY RunID) SELECT RunID,started,finished,DATEDIFF(minute,started,SYSUTCDATETIME()) AS age_minutes FROM x WHERE started IS NOT NULL AND finished IS NULL ORDER BY started DESC

queries.name: automatic_run_unit_counts
queries.sql: SELECT run_id,MIN(run_timestamp) AS primero,MAX(run_timestamp) AS ultimo,COUNT(DISTINCT unidad_negocio_id) AS unidades,COUNT(*) AS logs FROM dbo.Comercial_SyncLog_v2 WHERE run_type='INCREMENTAL' AND run_id LIKE 'INCR-%' AND run_timestamp>=DATEADD(hour,-24,SYSUTCDATETIME()) GROUP BY run_id ORDER BY primero DESC
